name: Stormwind Harbor - Auberdine boat
notes: New direct two-way sailing between Stormwind and Darkshore.

name: Menethil - Southshore - Auberdine ferry loop
to: Southshore, Hillsbrad Foothills; then Auberdine, Darkshore; then back to Menethil
notes: One-way triangle route. Ships from Menethil call at Southshore before going on to Auberdine, then return to Menethil.

name: Steamwheedle Port - Powderfuse Port boat
notes: New Steamwheedle Cartel sailing open to both factions. It is the sea route into the new Riverglades zone (about levels 35-45).

name: Valanaar - Dalaran skycutter
notes: Airship ('skycutter') from the eastern Valanaar skydock. Skyborne leave this way after finishing the Zephras Isle campaign.

name: Valanaar - Skywatcher Plateau zeppelin
to: Skywatcher Plateau, Mulgore (NW corner, outside Thunder Bluff)
notes: Horde airship route from the western Valanaar skydock.

notes: Unchanged from Classic.

name: Feathermoon ferry

name: Orgrimmar - Undercity zeppelin

notes: Unchanged from Classic.

name: Orgrimmar - Grom'gol zeppelin

name: Undercity - Grom'gol zeppelin
notes: Unchanged from Classic.

name: Deeprun Tram
notes: Unchanged from Classic.

name: Launch-night dock portals
from: Near most boat docks and inside zeppelin towers
to: The matching destination of each boat or zeppelin
notes: Boats and zeppelins went missing for long periods on launch night, so Blizzard placed temporary portals beside them. Blizzard said they will be removed once a proper fix is in.

name: Farholde Keep flight master
to: Lakeshire (Redridge), Thelsamar (Loch Modan), Morgan's Vigil (Burning Steppes)
notes: New Alliance flight point. A Farholde-Powderfuse Port route appeared in pre-launch files but is not in the live client.
